item.title: Health care data breach affects over 600k patients, Illinois agency says
item.description:
📝 More than 32,000 customers with the IDHS division of rehabilitation services had information publicly viewable between April 2021 and September 2025. The information included names, addresses, case numbers, case status, referral source information, region and office information and status as Division of Rehabilitation Services recipients, the agency said. Individuals whose information was made public will receive a notice about the leak from IDHS.
🔗 Read more: https://www.nprillinois.org/illinois/2026-01-06/health-care-data-breach-affects-600-000-patients-illinois-agency-says
